description: This file defines the XmlBody class responsible for serializing various AWS API shapes into XML format for REST-XML services, including methods for building XML documents, handling different shape types, and managing XML namespaces and attributes.

classes.name: XmlBody
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing AWS API shapes into XML format for REST-XML services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XmlBody with an AWS Service object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an XML string from a given shape and arguments.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Starts an XML element and writes namespace attributes if present.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Dispatches shape formatting to specific methods based on shape type.

methods.name: defaultShape
methods.description: Handles default serialization for simple shapes.

methods.name: add_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structure shape into XML.

methods.name: getStructureMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a structure shape for serialization.

methods.name: add_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into XML.

methods.name: add_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into XML.

methods.name: add_blob
methods.description: Serializes binary data as base64-encoded string.

methods.name: add_timestamp
methods.description: Serializes a timestamp shape into XML with specified format.

methods.name: add_boolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean shape into 'true' or 'false'.

methods.name: add_string
methods.description: Serializes a string shape, as an attribute or element.
